recent.text: ICYMI: The Vegas Golden Knights have really only known winning throughout their ten-year history. They’re unfamiliar with late collapses and being outplayed in games they were supposed to win. Last night’s historic overtime loss feels important. https://t.co/u3DgmdK3pZ

recent.text: This is the first time that the Vegas Golden Knights have lost a game when leading by two with two minutes remaining. It is also the first time that the Vegas Golden Knights have lost a game when leading by two with FIVE minutes remaining.

recent.text: “I see it as we played 58 minutes of real good hockey and didn’t finish the job.” William Karlsson, Brayden McNabb, and Head Coach Ryan Craig spoke to the media following Tuesday’s overtime loss against the Stars. https://t.co/2BhPXKIbPP
recent.author: Vegas Golden Knights

recent.text: Brayden McNabb: “For the most part, we did okay. But at the end of the day, you’ve gotta bear down and get through that. We didn’t, and here we are.”

recent.text: The Dallas Stars complete the improbable comeback in OT, Miro Heiskanen the winner. The VGK had their chances to put this one away many times, 0-5 on the PP Which loss stings more Sunday v. Vancouver or tonight v. Dallas? #VegasBorn
